(() => {
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.style.width = '37px';
  const content = document.createElement('div');
  content.innerHTML = '<div></div>'.repeat(100);
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = 'div{display:block}';
  document.head.append(style);
  document.body.append(target,content);
  const display = getComputedStyle(target).display === 'block';
  let layoutLimited = false;
  try { target.getBoundingClientRect(); } catch(error) { layoutLimited = error.message.endsWith('resource limit: layout tree: nodes'); }
  content.remove();
  style.remove();
  const recovered = target.getBoundingClientRect().width === 37;
  target.remove();
  return {display,layoutLimited,recovered};
})()
